records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total revenue decreased by $7.8 million, or 8.0%, to $89.0 million from $96.8 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: We have existing relationships with all major OEMs or their tier 1 suppliers, and while our customer contracts vary, they generally represent multi-year engagements, giving us some level of visibility into future revenue.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: As of June 30, 2022, our net working capital, excluding deferred revenue and deferred costs, was $168.5 million.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Operating margin increased 2.3 percentage points to 17.7% from 15.4%.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash used in operating activities was $3.9 million, a decrease of $28.0 million from cash provided by operating activities of $24.1 million.
